description: Yaara reads the program's sources and keeps the portfolio current. Ask her how anything is going, what is blocked, what was decided, what is in intake, what a change would affect, or what is loaded in ClickHouse.

title: How is the portfolio doing?
objectives and their health
suggestion_prompts.content: How is the portfolio doing overall? Which objectives need attention?

title: What is blocked?
and who owns clearing it
suggestion_prompts.content: What is blocked right now, and who owns clearing each one?

title: What would a change affect?
asked of the workflow map
suggestion_prompts.content: If we change how we classify automotive ads, what would that affect?

title: Is a dataset loaded?
from the Data Dictionary
suggestion_prompts.content: Is the Sports Sponsorship dataset loaded in ClickHouse, and what should I watch out for?

title: What is top of intake?
ranked by score
suggestion_prompts.content: What are the top requests in intake by score?

title: How is engineering doing?
from the Engineering Weekly
suggestion_prompts.content: How is the engineering team doing this week?
